whop@0.16.3 — Build and manage Whop apps from your terminal.
API version: 2026-08-25-2

Usage: whop <command>

GET STARTED
  quickstart               Start here — choose or create the business used by the CLI
  apps                     Build and deploy fully-hosted web apps (*.whop.app)
  upgrade                  Update the CLI to the latest version

COMMERCE
  products                 The things you sell. Each owns plans and a store page.
  plans                    Pricing for a product: one-time, recurring, trials, stock.
  promo-codes              Discounts that creators configure for checkout.
  memberships              A customer's purchase of a plan, from checkout through cancellation.
  checkout-configurations  Turn a plan into a shareable, prefilled checkout link.
  payment-method-domains   Domains verified to show wallet payment methods like Apple Pay at checkout.
  shipments                Track the delivery of an order by its carrier tracking number.

CORE RESOURCES
  accounts                 A business on Whop: profile, wallet, capabilities, settings.
  users                    A person on Whop: profile and connected identities.
  team-members             An account's team members and the roles that scope their access.
  members                  One buyer's relationship with an account, across all their purchases.
  webhooks                 Event notifications pushed to your server as things happen.
  stats                    Aggregated financial, audience, and traffic reporting.
  verifications            Legal identity required before payouts and card issuing.
  exports                  Asynchronous CSV dumps of an account's dashboard data.

NOTIFICATIONS
  notifications            The user's notification feed: unread badges, mark-read, app sends, and the topic catalog.

MONEY
  payments                 A charge against a buyer, and the step they still owe.
  setup-intents            Saving a buyer's payment method without charging it.
  ledgers                  The activity feed behind an account or user's balance.
  payouts                  Send money from a balance to a bank or wallet.
  cards                    Issue cards that spend from a balance.
  transfers                Move funds between Whop accounts and users.
  disputes                 Chargebacks filed against an account, with evidence and outcomes.
  dispute-alerts           Issuer warnings that arrive before a chargeback does.
  deposits                 Add funds to a balance.
  swaps                    Convert a balance between currencies.
  resolution-center-cases  File or respond to a case against a payment, as the buyer or the merchant.

PARTNERS
  partners                 The users and businesses you referred to Whop, and what you earn from them.

WORKFORCE
  bounties                 Paid tasks with reviewed submissions and escrowed rewards.
  bounty-submissions       Work submitted to a bounty, from attempt to payout.

TRACKING
  people                   Visitors and customers of an account, with identity, purchase, and traffic profiles.
  events                   Conversion and engagement events tracked for attribution.
  recommended-actions      Suggested next-step action chains for an account.

ADS
  ads                      The creative: copy, assets, and destination URL.
  ad-campaigns             Platform, objective, and budget for a set of ads.
  ad-groups                Audience, placements, and schedule within a campaign.
  audiences                Reusable targeting lists for ad groups.

MEDIA
  files                    Upload files and attach them wherever Whop accepts documents.
  media                    AI-generated assets, billed from a balance, attachable wherever files are accepted.

IDENTITY
  social-accounts          Connected Facebook and Instagram accounts that run ads.

DEVELOPER
  app-builds               Versioned build artifacts deployed to an app's platforms.
  api-keys                 Programmatic credentials for an account or app.
  permissions              What your credential is allowed to do on a resource.
  files                    Create file uploads and retrieve uploaded file details

AUTH
  auth                     Manage authentication
  login                    Sign in to Whop
  logout                   Sign out

Integrations:
  completions  Generate shell completion script
  mcp add      Register as MCP server
  skills       Sync skill files to agents (add, list)

Global Options:
  --filter-output <keys>              Filter output by key paths (e.g. foo,bar.baz,a[0,3])
  --format <toon|json|yaml|md|jsonl>  Output format
  --full-output                       Show full output envelope
  --help                              Show help
  --llms, --llms-full                 Print LLM-readable manifest
  --mcp                               Start as MCP stdio server
  --schema                            Show JSON Schema for command
  --token-count                       Print token count of output (instead of output)
  --token-limit <n>                   Limit output to n tokens
  --token-offset <n>                  Skip first n tokens of output
  --version                           Show CLI and API versions
